phonePinChooseHint: It unlocks the wallet and approves payments.

@phonePinChooseHint.description: Hint under the title of the first PIN step.

phonePinBiometricsBody: Face or fingerprint, whichever this phone has. The PIN still works.

@phonePinBiometricsBody.description: Text of the biometrics offer sheet after choosing a PIN.

phoneUnlockResetBody: The PIN cannot be recovered. You can delete this wallet from the phone and restore it from its recovery phrase. Without the phrase, its coins are lost for good.

@phoneUnlockResetBody.description: Body of the Forgot PIN sheet on the unlock screen.

phoneWelcomeBody: Make a wallet in under a minute, or bring one back with its recovery phrase.

@phoneWelcomeBody.description: Text under the Welcome title on the first screen.

phoneWelcomeTorLine: Connect through Tor from the first second

@phoneWelcomeTorLine.description: Line under the Tor only switch on the first screen.

@phoneStartPinHelpTitle.description: Title of the help sheet on the PIN step of the first start.

phoneStartPinHelpUnlock: The PIN unlocks the wallet on this phone and approves every payment. It never leaves the phone.

@phoneStartPinHelpUnlock.description: First line of the PIN help sheet.

phoneStartPinHelpLost: The PIN cannot be recovered. Keep the recovery phrase safe: with it you can restore the wallet and choose a new PIN.

@phoneStartPinHelpLost.description: Second line of the PIN help sheet.

@phoneRestoreHelpTitle.description: Title of the help sheet on the Restore screen.

phoneRestoreHelpPhrase: The recovery phrase brings back the balance. Type its words, paste them or scan its QR code.

@phoneRestoreHelpPhrase.description: First line of the Restore help sheet.

phoneRestoreHelpStart: Pick the month you made the wallet. Not sure? An earlier month finds more and takes longer.

@phoneRestoreHelpStart.description: Second line of the Restore help sheet.

@phoneRestoreScan.description: Button at the foot of the phrase box that scans the phrase from a QR code.

@phoneRestoreStartGroup.description: Label above the row that picks where the restore search starts.

@phoneRestoreCreated.description: Row that shows the month the wallet was made; it opens the month choice.

@phoneRestoreRestoring.description: Title of the Restore screen while the search runs.

@phoneRestoreScanTitle.description: Heading under the progress ring while the restore searches the chain.

phoneRestoreScanBody: Keep the app open until this finishes. The screen stays on while it runs.

@phoneRestoreScanBody.description: Line under the heading while the restore searches the chain.

@phoneRestoreLookingFrom.description: Row that shows where the restore search started.

phoneRestoreScanNote: Sending and receiving open when the search ends. If you stop, it carries on from Home.

@phoneRestoreScanNote.description: Dim note under the restore progress.

@phoneRestoreStoppedTitle.description: Heading when the restore search stopped before the end.

phoneRestoreDoneBody: The recovery phrase brought back the balance. History, contacts and settings come back from a wallet data file, if you exported one.

@phoneRestoreDoneBody.description: Text under the Your wallet is restored heading.
